PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES
  SEPTEMBER 16, 2025, 5:30 PM
  REGULAR MEETING

Commissioners Present: Chair Larry Giannone, Vice Chair Bob Olander, Patrick Jones,
Commissioner Ruth Luevand, Commissioner Orlando Pimentel, Commissioner Greg Tober.

Commission Members Absent: Commissioner Karol Curtis (excused)

City/Sherrif Representatives: City Manager Brad McKinney, Assistant City Manager Travis Sais,
Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department Captain, Michael Moen

Call to Order: 5:30 PM

 ORAL COMMUNICATIONS  COMMENTS/RECOMMENDATIONS
  The new LASD Captain Michael Moen was
  introduced to the Commission.

  Public Comment: One member of the public
  inquired about the recycling center near TJ
  Maxx and suggested considering a no
  panhandling campaign with corresponding
  signage.
 BUSINESS ITEMS  COMMENTS/RECOMMENDATIONS
 BI.1 Approval of Minutes for May 20, 2025,  MOTION: Motion by Commissioner Patrick
 Public Safety Commission Meeting  Jones, seconded by Commissioner Orlando
  Pimentel to approve the minutes of May 20,
  2025. Motion carried 6-0.

  Yes: Giannone, Olander, Jones, Luevand,
  Pimentel, Tober
  No: None
  Absent: Curtis
  Abstain: None
 REPORTS  COMMENTS/RECOMMENDATIONS
 R1 Commission Reports  Commissioner Pimentel:
  • Noted drivers crossing railroad tracks
  immediately after the arms rise, even
  while the lights are still flashing.
  • Requested a Deputy to patrol the area
  of 3rd St. and Eucla Ave. and 4th St.
  and Eucla Ave. between 8:00 a.m.
  and 12:00 p.m.
 Approve Minutes of September 16, 2025 Public Safety Commission Meeting  Page 2
For the Meeting of November 18, 2025

  •  Recommended future installation of
  LED stop signs and speed humps.
  •  Mentioned an issue with Bonita
  Ave./Eucla Ave. bus stop and buses
  often missing scheduled times.
  •  Noted several recent incidents in the
  downtown area involving dogs off-
  leash.

  Commissioner Luevand:
  • Requested investing in drone
  technology for events for safety
  purposes.
  • Inquired about receiving the Sheriff’s
  Department’s drone policies.
  • Requested a Metro safety spotlight
  on MySanDimas App and on city
  website.
  • Inquired about having more security
  at the polls on November 4th.
  • Requested making a public safety
  video about creating an emergency
  go-pack and encouraging youth
  Sheriff explorers to put together
  safety videos.

  Commissioner Tober:
  • Commented on there being one motor
  deputy in the City.
  • Mentioned there is speeding near
  Shull elementary school and along
  San Dimas Canyon Road when kids
  are getting on and off the bus for
  school.
  • Mentioned speeding occurs along
  San Dimas Canyon Road and
  Terrebonne Avenue (southbound),
  primarily occurring between 7:00 a.m.
  and 8:00 a.m.
  • Asked for more details on how the
  Sheriff’s Department’s drone system
  works and resources available.
  • Asked about Metro and Sheriff
  Department homelessness teams.

  Commissioner Olander:
  • Raised a concern regarding event
  parking and public notification for the
  July 3, 2026 event that the 2026
  Committee is assisting with.
 Approve Minutes of September 16, 2025 Public Safety Commission Meeting  Page 3
For the Meeting of November 18, 2025

  •  Emphasized that clear communication
  about where attendees should park is
  critical and could become a safety
  issue if not handled properly.

  City Manager McKinney and Captain Moen,
  along with Commissioner Jones, provided
  responses to the Commissioners' questions.
 R2 City Staff Reports  Captain Moen reported that the opening of
  the A-line will be accompanied by additional
  enforcement in the surrounding area. Overall,
  year-to-date crime statistics show significant
  improvement, with overall crime down 26%,
  robberies down 87%, larceny down 26%, and
  grand theft auto down 50%. However, arsons
  are up due to transients starting smaller fires.
  Regarding the six reported arson incidents,
  the Sheriff’s Department had three individuals
  in custody and was actively working to locate
  one other identified suspect.

Adjourned: 6:34 PM

I, Travis Sais, Assistant City Manager, attest that these minutes are accurate and reflective of
the actions taken by the Public Safety Commission.

_______________________________
Travis Sais, Assistant City Manager
